purpose: Diagnose why local APT capability discovery fails to surface the known zero-cost zbar-tools semantic verifier.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python canonical/tests/test_capability_discovery.py
echo '--- POLICY ---'
apt-cache policy zbar-tools || true
echo '--- DIRECT ---'
apt-cache search zbar | head -n 50 || true
echo '--- BAR CODE ---'
apt-cache search 'bar code' | grep -i -E 'zbar|scanner|decoder' | head -n 80 || true
echo '--- PYTHON DISCOVERY ---'
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,pathlib,json
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/capability_discovery.py')
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('d',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
out=m.search_apt_packages('decode barcode image',limit=100)
hits=[x for x in out['candidates'] if 'zbar' in x.get('name','').lower()]
print(json.dumps({'queries':out.get('queries'),'hits':hits,'top':out['candidates'][:40]},sort_keys=True))
PY
